name: SPARx — Recommendation Engine (v4.2: dual-DB — Supabase app data + legacy clinical)

parameters.query:
=-- SUPABASE (app DB): one row per user with app signals + candidate pools.
-- LIVE clinical signals (ai_notes / treatment plan) come from the NEXT node,
-- which reads the legacy production DB; the ai_notes copy read here is only
-- the fallback (Supabase carries periodic import copies of clinical tables).
-- Inputs (validated by the Code node): user_id, ai_note_id, auth_uid.
with target as (
  select coalesce(
    {{ $json.user_id ?? 'NULL' }}::int,
    (select user_id from public.ai_notes where id = {{ $json.ai_note_id ?? 'NULL' }}::bigint),
    (select mc.app_user_id from public.mobile_checkins mc
      where mc.auth_uid = {{ $json.auth_uid ? "'" + $json.auth_uid + "'" : 'NULL' }}::uuid
        and mc.app_user_id is not null
      order by mc.date desc limit 1),
    (select vw.app_user_id from public.mobile_video_watches vw
      where vw.auth_uid = {{ $json.auth_uid ? "'" + $json.auth_uid + "'" : 'NULL' }}::uuid
        and vw.app_user_id is not null
      order by vw.watched_at desc limit 1)
  ) as user_id
)
select
  u.id                                     as user_id,
  au.auth_uid                              as auth_uid,
  '{{ $json.source }}'                     as source,
  coalesce(a.title, 'recovery')            as addiction_label,
  coalesce(ci.checkins,       '[]'::json)  as recent_checkins,
  coalesce(pc.prod_checkins,  '[]'::json)  as prod_checkins,
  coalesce(nt.note_context,   '[]'::json)  as session_notes,
  coalesce(tp.plan_items,     '[]'::json)  as treatment_plan,
  coalesce(wl.low_areas,      '[]'::json)  as lowest_wheel_areas,
  coalesce(cl.lessons,        '[]'::json)  as recent_lessons,
  cand.candidates                          as candidates,
  coalesce(lc.lesson_candidates, '[]'::json) as lesson_candidates
from public.users u
cross join target t
left join public.addictions a on a.enum_id = u.addiction
-- resolve this user's Supabase auth id (webhook-supplied on single-user runs,
-- else via app-owned tables that carry both keys)
left join lateral (
  select coalesce(
    {{ $json.auth_uid ? "'" + $json.auth_uid + "'" : 'NULL' }}::uuid,
    (select mc.auth_uid from public.mobile_checkins mc
      where mc.app_user_id = u.id order by mc.date desc limit 1),
    (select vw.auth_uid from public.mobile_video_watches vw
      where vw.app_user_id = u.id order by vw.watched_at desc limit 1)
  ) as auth_uid
) au on true
-- last 5 app check-ins (mood 0-100, emotion tags, use behaviour)
left join lateral (
  select json_agg(json_build_object(
           'date', mc.date, 'mood', mc.mood,
           'struggling_with', mc.negative, 'feeling_good_about', mc.positive,
           'used', mc.behavior, 'amount_vs_usual', mc.amount)
         order by mc.date desc) as checkins
  from (select * from public.mobile_checkins
        where app_user_id = u.id or auth_uid = au.auth_uid
        order by date desc limit 5) mc
) ci on true
-- last 5 production daily assessments (legacy check-in path: i_am + emotions;
-- Supabase import copy — good enough as a background signal)
left join lateral (
  select json_agg(x) as prod_checkins from (
    select da.created_at::date as date, da.i_am,
           max(case when e2.is_negative then e2.name end)                      as negative,
           max(case when not coalesce(e2.is_negative, false) then e2.name end) as positive
    from public.daily_assessments da
    left join public.daily_assessment_emotions e on da.id = e.daily_assessment_id
    left join public.emotions e2 on e.emotion_id = e2.id
    where da.user_id = u.id
    group by da.id, da.created_at, da.i_am
    order by da.created_at desc
    limit 5
  ) x
) pc on true
-- FALLBACK copy of SOAP session notes (Supabase import; the live version is
-- fetched from the legacy DB by the next node and wins when present)
left join lateral (
  select json_agg(json_build_object(
           'date', n.session_date, 'type', n.session_type, 'title', n.session_title,
           'tags', n.summary_tags,
           'assessment', n.assessment_analysis,
           'plan_next', n.plan_analysis,
           'risk', n.a_risk)
         order by n.session_date desc nulls last) as note_context
  from (
    select coalesce(an.support_datetime, an.support_date, an.created_at) as session_date,
           coalesce(an.session_type, 'session')                          as session_type,
           an.session_title,
           an.summary_tags,
           left(coalesce(an.assessment_analysis, ''), 400)               as assessment_analysis,
           left(coalesce(an.plan_analysis, ''), 400)                     as plan_analysis,
           an.a_risk
    from public.ai_notes an
    where an.user_id = u.id
      and (an.assessment_analysis is not null or an.plan_analysis is not null)
    order by coalesce(an.support_datetime, an.support_date, an.created_at) desc
    limit 5
  ) n
) nt on true
-- Treatment plan does NOT exist in Supabase (ai_treatment_plans lives only in
-- the legacy DB) — stubbed here; the live version comes from the next node.
left join lateral (select null::json as plan_items) tp on true
-- 3 lowest current Wheel of Life areas — production scores (0-10) UNIONed with
-- app retakes from mobile_wheel_entries (0-100, scaled /10), newest per area
left join lateral (
  select json_agg(json_build_object('area', r.title, 'score', r.score) order by r.score) as low_areas
  from (
    select la.title, x.score
    from (
      select distinct on (s.life_area_id) s.life_area_id, s.score
      from (
        select ws.life_area_id, ws.score::numeric as score, ws.created_at as at
        from public.wheel_of_life_scores ws
        where ws.user_id = u.id
        union all
        select we.life_area_id, round(we.score / 10.0, 1) as score, we.taken_at as at
        from public.mobile_wheel_entries we
        where we.auth_uid = au.auth_uid
      ) s
      order by s.life_area_id, s.at desc
    ) x
    join public.life_areas la on la.id = x.life_area_id
    order by x.score asc
    limit 3
  ) r
) wl on true
-- 5 most recently touched lessons (topic signal)
left join lateral (
  select json_agg(l.title order by c.at desc) as lessons
  from (
    select cl.lesson_id, max(cl.updated_at) as at
    from public.completed_lessons cl
    where cl.user_id = u.id
    group by cl.lesson_id
    order by 2 desc nulls last
    limit 5
  ) c
  join public.lessons l on l.id = c.lesson_id
) cl on true
-- VIDEO candidates: classified snippets with a playable video, not recommended
-- to this user in 60 days, and NOT already watched (>=85% in the app). Newest 40.
join lateral (
  select json_agg(json_build_object(
           'snippet_id', c.id, 'title', c.title,
           'summary', c.summary, 'seconds', c.length_seconds)) as candidates
  from (
    select s.id,
           coalesce(nullif(trim(s.title), ''),
                    nullif(nullif(trim(s.description), ''), 'No description available'),
                    left(s.ai_summary, 80),
                    'Untitled video')            as title,
           left(coalesce(s.ai_summary, ''), 280) as summary,
           s.length_seconds
    from public.snippets s
    where s.classified = true
      and (s.vimeo_id is not null or s.vimeo_url is not null)
      and not exists (
        select 1 from public.user_snippets us
        where us.user_id = u.id and us.snippet_id = s.id
          and us.created_at > now() - interval '60 days')
      and not exists (
        select 1 from public.mobile_video_watches vw
        where vw.video_id = s.id::text and vw.percent >= 85
          and (vw.app_user_id = u.id or vw.auth_uid = au.auth_uid))
    order by s.created_at desc
    limit 40
  ) c
) cand on true
-- LESSON/WORKSHOP candidates: entitled to this user, not completed, not
-- recommended in 60 days.
left join lateral (
  select json_agg(json_build_object(
           'lesson_id', k.id,
           'content_type', k.content_type,
           'title', k.title,
           'description', k.description)) as lesson_candidates
  from (
    select l.id,
           case l.lesson_type when 1 then 'workshop' else 'lesson' end as content_type,
           coalesce(nullif(trim(l.title), ''), l.nav_title, 'Untitled') as title,
           left(coalesce(l.description, ''), 240)                      as description
    from public.lessons l
    left join public.portions p on p.id = l.portion_id
    where (
        (p.program_id is not null and p.program_id = u.program_id)
        or (l.lesson_type = 1 and exists (
              select 1 from public.subscription_role_workshops srw
              where srw.role_id = u.subscription_role_id and srw.workshop_id = l.id))
        or (coalesce(l.lesson_type, 0) <> 1 and exists (
              select 1 from public.subscription_role_lessons srl
              where srl.role_id = u.subscription_role_id and srl.lesson_id = l.id))
      )
      -- adjust the completed threshold if progress_value is 0-1 in your data
      and not exists (
        select 1 from public.completed_lessons cl2
        where cl2.user_id = u.id and cl2.lesson_id = l.id
          and coalesce(cl2.progress_value, 0) >= 100)
      and not exists (
        select 1 from public.mobile_recommended_content rc
        where rc.user_id = u.id and rc.content_id = l.id
          and rc.content_type in ('lesson', 'workshop')
          and rc.created_at > now() - interval '60 days')
    order by l.position nulls last
    limit 30
  ) k
) lc on true
where cand.candidates is not null
  and ( (t.user_id is not null and u.id = t.user_id)
     -- batch ONLY on the daily schedule — a webhook that failed to resolve a
     -- user can never fan out to everyone
     or (t.user_id is null and '{{ $json.source }}' = 'daily' and (
           exists (
             select 1 from public.mobile_checkins mc
             where (mc.app_user_id = u.id or mc.auth_uid = au.auth_uid)
               and mc.date >= (now() - interval '14 days')::date)
           or exists (
             select 1 from public.ai_notes an2
             where an2.user_id = u.id
               and coalesce(an2.support_datetime, an2.created_at) >= now() - interval '14 days')
           or exists (
             select 1 from public.mobile_xp_events xe
             where xe.auth_uid = au.auth_uid
               and xe.created_at >= now() - interval '14 days')
         )) )
limit 500;

=-- LEGACY PRODUCTION DB: the LIVE clinical signals. ai_notes and the treatment
-- plan are written here by the SOAP & Treatment Plan workflows; Supabase only
-- has import copies. Fail-open: if this node errors, the engine falls back to
-- the Supabase copies from the previous node. READ-ONLY.
select
  coalesce(nt.note_context, '[]'::json) as session_notes_live,
  coalesce(tp.plan_items,   '[]'::json) as treatment_plan_live
from (select {{ $json.user_id }}::int as uid) t
left join lateral (
  select json_agg(json_build_object(
           'date', n.session_date, 'type', n.session_type, 'title', n.session_title,
           'tags', n.summary_tags,
           'assessment', n.assessment_analysis,
           'plan_next', n.plan_analysis,
           'risk', n.a_risk)
         order by n.session_date desc nulls last) as note_context
  from (
    select coalesce(an.support_datetime, an.support_date, an.created_at) as session_date,
           coalesce(an.session_type, 'session')                          as session_type,
           an.session_title,
           an.summary_tags,
           left(coalesce(an.assessment_analysis, ''), 400)               as assessment_analysis,
           left(coalesce(an.plan_analysis, ''), 400)                     as plan_analysis,
           an.a_risk
    from public.ai_notes an
    where an.user_id = t.uid
      and (an.assessment_analysis is not null or an.plan_analysis is not null)
    order by coalesce(an.support_datetime, an.support_date, an.created_at) desc
    limit 5
  ) n
) nt on true
left join lateral (
  select json_agg(json_build_object('goal', p.code_label, 'plan_item', p.item_content)
                  order by p.updated_at desc) as plan_items
  from (
    select distinct on (tpi.sds_code_id) sc.code_label, tpi.item_content, tpi.updated_at
    from public.ai_treatment_plan_items tpi
    left join public.sds_codes sc on tpi.sds_code_id = sc.id
    where tpi.ai_treatment_plan_id = public.get_or_create_ai_treatment_plan_id(t.uid)
      and tpi.status_id in (254183, 254184)
    order by tpi.sds_code_id, tpi.updated_at desc
  ) p
) tp on true;

=-- SUPABASE: app-side context in one call — identity, focus, assessments
-- (+history), activity, gamification, SAFETY FLAGS. Fail-open like the
-- clinical node. auth_uid comes from the Gather node (uuid or null).
select public.mobile_ai_context({{ $('Gather user signals + candidates').item.json.auth_uid ? "'" + $('Gather user signals + candidates').item.json.auth_uid + "'" : 'NULL' }}::uuid) as app_ctx;

=-- SUPABASE: recommended VIDEOS go into user_snippets (read by the deployed
-- app via the mobile_recommended_videos view). INSERT-ONLY; the NOT EXISTS makes
-- re-runs idempotent. user_id / video_id_list are validated integers.
insert into public.user_snippets (user_id, snippet_id, created_at, updated_at)
select {{ $json.user_id }}, sid, now(), now()
from unnest(array[{{ $json.video_id_list }}]::bigint[]) as sid
where {{ $json.has_videos }}
  and sid > 0
  and not exists (
    select 1 from public.user_snippets us
    where us.user_id = {{ $json.user_id }}
      and us.snippet_id = sid
      and us.created_at > now() - interval '60 days'
)
returning snippet_id;

=-- SUPABASE: provenance ledger (append-only): EVERY pick — videos, lessons,
-- workshops — with its reason and the signal snapshot that drove it.
insert into public.mobile_recommended_content
  (user_id, content_type, content_id, reason, signals_used, model, prompt_version, run_source)
select {{ $json.user_id }},
       p->>'content_type',
       (p->>'content_id')::bigint,
       p->>'reason',
       '{{ $json.signals_sql }}'::jsonb,
       'claude-opus-4-8',
       'v4.2',
       '{{ $json.source }}'
from json_array_elements('{{ $json.ledger_sql }}'::json) p;

meta._comment: SPARx recommendation engine v4.2 — dual-database topology: Supabase (app data, candidates, RPC, writes) + legacy production Postgres (LIVE ai_notes + treatment plan; Supabase only holds import copies). Credentials: nodes marked REPLACE_SUPABASE -> the Supabase credential; the 'Clinical signals (legacy DB)' node -> the original legacy 'Postgres account'. Both context nodes are fail-open (alwaysOutputData + continue-on-error). Batch runs only fire from the daily schedule; webhooks that fail to resolve a user are dropped. Do NOT set temperature on the Anthropic node; if your key lacks Opus access, set the model By-ID to claude-sonnet-4-6 and mirror it in the Provenance ledger's model line.
